items.t: 400 mg once daily. Duration: acute exacerbation of COPD/bronchitis 5 to 10 days; community-acquired pneumonia 10 days; acute bacterial sinusitis 7 days; mild to moderate pelvic inflammatory disease 14 days. Do not exceed the dose or duration.

items.t: Tendinitis and tendon rupture (often Achilles, can be bilateral) from 48 hours to months after stopping. Higher risk: older patients (MHRA: over 60), renal impairment, solid organ transplant, corticosteroid use. Stop at the first sign of tendinitis.

items.t: Elderly with renal disorders who cannot keep up fluid intake: use with caution (dehydration may increase renal failure risk). Avoid UV and strong sunlight. rules.consequence: Reduced moxifloxacin absorption.
rules.sourceWording: An interval of about 6 hours should be left

src.q: An interval of about 6 hours should be left between administration of agents containing bivalent or trivalent cations (e.g. antacids containing magnesium or aluminium, didanosine tablets, sucralfate and agents containing iron or zinc) and administration of moxifloxacin.
